reviewDiscipline.memoryRequest: disabled; requested versus actually verified recorded
reviewDiscipline.scopeAccess: Full positive global BODY/selected data; no unlisted origins or stored-command evaluation.
reviewDiscipline.reading: Complete mandatory scope, truthful substantive assessment, no sampling/arbitrary row/byte/array cap; avoid and recover truncation/EOF/parser/query errors.
reviewDiscipline.delivery: No codec is mandatory. Independently authored complete exact identity/value comparisons are permitted evidence for opaque identity strings. Full semantic selectors/absence/arrays/order/default/filter/dependency relationships require substantive interpretation, not hashes/counts alone.
reviewDiscipline.materialGap: Read necessary globally granted source/callers/data. A necessary ungranted primary requires amendment/refreeze or precise BLOCKED.
reviewDiscipline.metadataPresence: Query each selected metadata record only through its own positive field list. Test actual property presence before rendering; preserve absent, explicit null, false, arrays/order/case and complete opaque values. Neutral recovery identifies a query/rendering error and rereads permitted data accurately; discarding an earlier output does not make it unexposed or grant unselected fields.
reviewDiscipline.exactCaseDataRead: Use Ordinal (or explicitly equivalent case-sensitive) keys for any literal field-name or string-value grouping, with complete occurrence mappings back to the original selected row, array index and key. Do not merge case-different field names or string values. Before crediting a projection, independently verify complete selected values, JSON types, key presence/absence and occurrence coverage against the positively granted originals; preserve null, false, empty and singleton arrays, order, full strings and every difference or query/rendering loss. Identity/value comparisons establish data integrity only and do not by themselves establish substantive semantic review; consumer-specific case resolution needs its own source-supported interpretation.
reviewDiscipline.generatedRuntimeAndInvocation: Generated reviewer runtime, invocation, stdout, private sessions and transport outputs have no reviewer BODY grant. Root independently records actual selector/isolation, prompt/GO transmission and closed execution evidence; panel records limits of root-supplied attestation rather than inspecting ungranted generated artifacts. Existing source transport code may be inspected only through its positive BODY grants.
finiteRulesWitnessCriteria: Before the one owned EditorBuild process, retain exact fresh staged topology, all33 canonical/staged source-member pairs and relevant scanner boundary files/absences. Acquire the approved member handles before deriving their descriptors, independently compare complete membership and frozen bytes while held. Recheck the approved source bytes and topology immediately before the owned root; retain the existing exact challenge/input/process joins. Hold all66 canonical/staged member streams against writes/deletion through exit; those handles do not prevent directory insertion or establish continuous monitoring. Keep the exact7 C# rules-source sequence distinct from the full33 member topology, retain the required cache-root/optional-absence policy, reject unexpected source/extension/additional-root/Mods/Tests/pruning inputs, and create same-run CreateNew input/topology/nonce records. The full source, hold, hash, challenge, launch and finally-release failure paths require meaningful tests of the real preparation route; stubbing that route cannot substantiate its preservation guards.

Launch the exact frozen dotnet host and UBT DLL directly as the existing owned EditorBuild root. Retain suspended creation, private-job assignment before resume, PID and creation FILETIME, bounded execution, final cleanup and failure preservation. Bind the actual CWD, literal argv, controlled host environment and runtime assembly identities. An ancestor process or aggregate final job zero cannot substitute for the actual observed CLR process identity. A direct UBT invocation bypasses batch rebuilding/SDK-selection branches; do not claim those branches or `dotnet --version` executed. Keep actual CLR/runtime observations distinct from hash-bound installed SDK metadata.

The dedicated target retains its actual object/type and constructor-stage values through the supported AdditionalData bridge. At module construction after CreateTargetRules validation, observe that same target object and its live finite selector vector, including bBuildAllModules=false. Bind exact concrete target and module CLR types, their loaded assembly identity/location/MVID and source maps. Constructor values alone do not establish the later selector values or native compile environment. Refuse unexpected specialization, object/process mismatch, occupied/replaced bridge, unsupported selector or nonfrozen source.

Observe the already completed project RulesAssembly and its finite discovery cache poststate without constructing another assembly, forcing another Lazy, populating or invalidating caches, or running discovery again. Guard exact pinned private field/type shapes and read synchronization. Preserve actual project name maps, source arrays, roots, pruning/scan state and parent assembly lineage. An uncreated, absent, ambiguous or unsupported required state fails the proof.

Keep observed orders distinct: finite cache/name-map enumeration, actual AssemblySourceFiles enumeration and raw manifest SourceFiles array are separate facts. The compiler's FilePath sort is a source-derived expectation with its runtime comparer/culture inputs; it is not a captured internal syntax-tree event. Fresh owned process plus preabsence, materialized cache state and exact produced assembly/source identities support a bounded, source-supported first-population inference for this finite normal invocation. Do not label this chronological scan tracing or an observation of every cache hit, invalidation, temporary member or internal traversal. Unobserved cache layers remain explicit. No universal UBT/process/filesystem isolation claim follows.

Retain the actual project BuildRules DLL, portable PDB and ModuleRulesManifest bytes, their ordered source membership and exact input checksums. Validate the loaded MVID against metadata-only PE parsing of retained bytes, the DLL/PDB debug identity and every PDB document/checksum against the approved source. Never load the generated assembly into the wrapper to validate it. Observe the compiled source association without relabelling PDB document order as private compiler order. Preserve exact original/copy bindings and independently recheck the live named stage outputs in subsequent dependent phases.

EditorBuild success requires all process/input/challenge/type/selector/cache/ source/artifact/retention joins and the existing vendor/compiler/native-flag/ target-receipt checks. Missing, truncated, unsupported, mismatched or drifting evidence fails visibly. Preserve partial witnesses and generated artifacts after failure; a retention error is secondary to an existing primary failure. No completion or dependent phase follows an uncertain chain. A local producer witness is not cryptographic hostile-user attestation, native parser success, plugin activation or final acceptance.

Meaningful pure validator fixtures must cover positive complete joins and rejection of PID reuse/creation mismatch, wrong process/CWD/argv, challenge or cross-run swaps, wrong type/assembly/MVID, missing PDB/manifest, checksum/source/ order/selector mismatch, case-colliding JSON keys, unexpected topology/cache shapes, retained/live drift and primary-plus-secondary failure preservation. Pure fixtures prove validator behavior; they do not establish an installed UBT run, native execution or actual cache/API accessibility.
